rounds.text: Superhouse Ltd trades at an extraordinary discount to its asset base, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.38x based on a share price of ₹ 160 against a book value of ₹ 422 [E1]. This deep discount values the entire market capitalisation at a modest ₹ 178 Cr [E2], meaning the market is pricing the equity at a fraction of its underlying net worth. Furthermore, internal fundamentals are actively inflecting, evidenced by a quarterly operating margin reaching 8% in Mar 2026, which represents a strong 3 percentage point expansion compared to the year-ago quarter [E21]. This margin momentum underpins the screen reason identifying that margins are expanding [E55]. Conceded: the ten-year compounded sales growth stands at 0% [E7], and ROCE is depressed at 3.8% [E5]. Nevertheless, the sheer magnitude of the asset discount combined with the recent quarterly margin acceleration highlights an under-appreciated opportunity where expectations have heavily lagged operational reality [E1, E21].

Superhouse Ltd trades at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.38x, sitting at a share price of ₹ 160 against a substantial book value of ₹ 422 [E1]. This leaves the entire market capitalization at a modest ₹ 178 Cr [E2]. Far from a stagnant story, recent operational evidence shows genuine green shoots of internal recovery and margin repair. Quarterly operating margins have expanded to 8% in March 2026, marking a notable three percentage point increase compared to 6% in the year-ago quarter [E21]. This margin expansion forms the core bull screen reason [E55], proving the business is successfully capturing efficiency even amidst top-line headwinds. Conceded: [E5], [E6], [E7], [E9], [E51], [E60], [E61].
